purpose: Freeze the append-only evidence format and reload gate that bind every Mem-Gallery dense-control vector to its exact answer-free source text, scenario, memory_id or qid, method, seed, encoder identity, request, batch offset, and durable endpoint call record.
scientific_boundary: This artifact establishes provenance and denominator integrity for future dense retrieval. It uses synthetic vectors only, observes no real retrieval result or answer, and estimates no method quality.

registered_surface.document_count: Derived without omission from every ordered memory_record in the accepted 20-scenario projection.

surface_identity.document: Global projection order over scenario, memory record order, memory_id, chronological index, and SHA-256 of the exact captioned-text encoder input.
surface_identity.query: Global accepted order over scenario, qid, query position, and SHA-256 of the exact retrieval_query_text encoder input.
surface_identity.projection_hash: Canonical SHA-256 over both ordered identity surfaces; raw text and vectors are excluded.

writer_contract.root: An absent non-symlink exact child of an explicitly allowed run scope.
writer_contract.start: Create RUNNING metadata plus empty append-only document, query, call, and event files before embedding evidence is accepted.
writer_contract.accepted_batch: Require the next exact role offset, batch index, method, seed, profile, model, dimension, single attempt, zero retry, loopback endpoint, finite duration, exact usage, response evidence, and request SHA-256/byte length reconstructed from the frozen raw-text slice before appending vectors.
writer_contract.vectors: Persist finite numeric non-boolean exact-dimensional nonzero vectors with only hashed text identity, never raw source text.
writer_contract.complete: Only the full document and query surfaces can create TERMINAL_EMBEDDINGS_COMPLETE and a seven-file SHA-256 inventory.
writer_contract.reject: Retain accepted prefix vectors, all appended calls including a terminal failed call, failure metadata, inventory, and TERMINAL_REJECTED; same-root retry is false.

reload_contract.hash_gate: Require complete terminal state, no rejection marker, exactly seven signed files, no symlinks, and matching SHA-256 for every signed member.
reload_contract.semantic_gate: Independently recompute projection identity, model/method/seed/dataset bindings, start/identity/summary denominators, every request-to-text hash, call order, response evidence, token usage, and every vector invariant even if an artifact was maliciously re-signed.
reload_contract.runner_output: Return scenario-to-ordered-document-vector and qid-to-query-vector mappings plus accepted call records for direct injection into the already frozen control runner.

covered_invariants: complete write, hash inventory, semantic reload, and exact runner surface
request hash binding to the next frozen raw-text slice
batch index, input offset, and vector dimension rejection before append
partial accepted vectors and failed call retention
byte tamper rejection despite a complete terminal marker
malicious call re-signing rejected by semantic request reconstruction
projection order, duplicate identity, and raw-answer leak rejection

next_gate: Freeze a real service receipt and real control-family lifecycle successor that composes the accepted dataset projection, one-shot embedding client, this append-only artifact, exact tokenizer, matched answer endpoint, raw-run writer, and reconciliation without exposing scores before the numerical authorization boundary.
authorization: This synthetic-only artifact authorizes no real dataset read, vector generation, model load, service launch, endpoint call, prediction, score, comparison, SOTA claim, or cleanup.
explicitly_prohibited: reusing a vector artifact across method or seed without a separately frozen rule
embedding any text other than the exact captioned memory text or retrieval_query_text bound by the accepted projection
loading a partial, rejected, reordered, hash-drifted, dimension-drifted, or semantically re-signed artifact
dropping a failed embedding call or selectively repairing vectors in the same root
persisting raw memory or query text in the vector rows
treating synthetic vector persistence as a reproduced result
